description: One row of an Accordion: identified by value, headed by label, holding content below it while open.

constructors.description: A row for value, headed label, opening content.

params.name: label
params.description: The row's header, in TsuyaType.bodyStrong (ListItem styling): shown, and read for screen readers.

params.name: content
params.description: Shown below the header, TsuyaSpace.s16 padded, while the row is open.

params.name: disabled
params.description: Excluded from toggling (not toggled and not focusable: the header is skipped by Tab, as a native disabled button is).
